topic: Which country has no rivers at all? (Saudi Arabia — largest country with no permanent river)
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

britannica_sa.title: Saudi Arabia — Drainage and soils
britannica_sa.notes: virtually no permanent surface streams; wadis numerous; Rub al-Khali > 647,500 km², world’s largest sand area

wiki_sa.title: Saudi Arabia
wiki_sa.notes: land area ≈ 2,149,690 km²; largest country in the world without permanent rivers; Rub al Khali 647,500 km², largest contiguous sand desert

wiki_arabia.title: Arabian Peninsula
wiki_arabia.notes: few lakes or permanent rivers; drained by ephemeral wadis, dry except in the rainy season; ancient aquifers feed oases

geoworlds.title: Saudi Arabia Geography
geoworlds.notes: no permanent rivers or lakes; relies on desalination (~5.6 million m³/day) and fossil groundwater; Rub al Khali ≈ 650,000 km²

envblog.title: Countries With No Natural Rivers
envblog.notes: area ~2.15 million km²; rainfall < 100 mm/yr; ~50 % desalinated, ~40 % fossil groundwater

toi.title: Which country has no rivers at all?
toi.notes: Saudi Arabia has no rivers; annual rainfall often < 100 mm

fao_aquastat.title: Country profile – Saudi Arabia
fao_aquastat.notes: there are no permanent rivers or lakes; surface water is ephemeral wadi flow; water supply from non-renewable groundwater and desalination

britannica_rak.title: Rubʿ al-Khali
britannica_rak.notes: largest continuous sand desert; dunes reach heights of about 250 m (800 ft)

jarnias.title: Geography of Saudi Arabia
jarnias.notes: Rub al Khali dunes sometimes over 200 m high

unsc_497.title: Resolution 497 (1981) — Golan Heights
unsc_497.notes: Israeli annexation of the Golan Heights null and void; Syria claims the territory

ne_disputed.title: Admin 0 – Disputed areas (10m)
ne_disputed.notes: West Bank, Gaza, Halayib Triangle, Bir Tawil polygons with administering/claimant notes

un_ochaopt.title: Occupied Palestinian Territory — overview
un_ochaopt.notes: West Bank under Israeli occupation with Palestinian Authority in Areas A/B; Gaza access controlled by Israel

bbc_bir_tawil.title: Bir Tawil: the land no country wants
bbc_bir_tawil.notes: Bir Tawil claimed by neither Egypt nor Sudan; the Halaib Triangle is administered by Egypt and claimed by Sudan

myths.myth: Every country has at least one river.
myths.reality: About twenty countries have no permanent river; Saudi Arabia is by far the largest of them.
